cards.front: What should you know about photography exam tips?
cards.back: Research photographers within your CHOSEN genre — show you understand its conventions. Create a COHERENT body of work, not random single images. Annotate how your photographs fit (or deliberately challenge) the genre. Develop a recognisable personal style.

Students often make mistakes with this topic. Wrong: You need to specialise in just one genre to be a good photographer. Correct: While developing depth in one genre is valuable, AQA encourages BREADTH as well as depth. Understanding multiple genres gives you a wider visual vocabulary and more options for expressing your ideas. You can work across genres if your project requires it.
Create a small portfolio of 6-8 photographs within one genre. Research a photographer working in the same genre and show how their approach has informed your own. Annotate your creative decisions.
